page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn6i-c24g1.24xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server powered by 96 dedicated physical cores of an Intel Xeon 8163 processor running at 2.5 GHz. The system features 372.0 GB of system memory, providing approximately 3.88 GB of RAM per core. It is equipped with four NVIDIA T4 GPUs from the Turing family, delivering a combined 64 GB of VRAM. This server does not include local storage and relies on network-attached storage, supported by a baseline network bandwidth of 30 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks indicate a divergence between single-core and multi-core capabilities. Single-core CPU performance is relatively weak, as shown by a stress-ng single-core score of 1103.89 and a poor single-threaded gzip compression rate of 19.2 GB/sec. Conversely, multi-core execution is strong, with a multi-core stress-ng score of 70574.45 and a multi-threaded bzip3 decompression rate of 287.37 GB/sec. Memory bandwidth is highly efficient for small cached blocks, reaching 3924.63 GB/sec, while large-block uncached read and write operations perform at average rates of 147.24 GB/sec and 58.43 GB/sec, respectively. Redis SET operations are highly efficient, registering 64.27 million operations per second.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the server offers a high density of GPU resources and dedicated CPU cores, making it a viable option for parallelized workloads that can leverage multiple GPUs without requiring local storage. The lack of local storage requires external storage integration, which represents a key architectural tradeoff. This configuration is appropriate for multi-GPU deep learning inference, parallel data processing, multi-threaded decompression tasks, and high-throughput Redis caching layers.
